name: CodeGym
description: CodeGym is a scalable framework that synthesizes diverse, verifiable, and controllable multi-turn tool-use environments for reinforcement learning training of LLM agents. It converts static coding problems into interactive environments by extracting atomic functions as callable tools, enabling agents to explore and master various workflows with verifiable tasks.
reputation: A recent synthetic tool-use benchmark framework that is promising for agent training, but it is not yet a widely established community standard.
notes: Enables multi-turn tool-use RL training; supports out-of-distribution generalization; code publicly available.
